gh_c9dbe8c3245224e55d772ee5.title: Add an "Updated At" timestamp column so readers can spot new roles
gh_c9dbe8c3245224e55d772ee5.description:
The `Date Posted` column is day-level only, so when new roles get added between refreshes there's no way to tell which rows are new since my last visit — I have to re-scan the whole table from the top and remember where I left off.

Proposal: add a column (e.g. `Updated At`) showing the date + time each row was added or updated by the bot, like:

| Company | Job Title | Location | Date Posted | Updated At |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Company A | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 13:53 |
| Company B | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 17:54 |

This should be feasible since the bot already knows when it inserts each row (the timestamp is implicit in the commit history today) — persisting it per-row just makes it visible to everyone. Readers could then instantly see what's new since their last refresh.

## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Você vai atuar no desenvolvimento das interfaces dos nossos produtos, trabalhando com as duas gerações de UI da empresa (MUI v5 + Emotion + design system @truckpag/components nos projetos legados e Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Radix UI + Lucide nos projetos novos), em colaboração com os times de back-end e mobile. ### Responsabilidades * Escrever código e funções facilmente testáveis e compreendidas por outros desenvolvedores, considerando casos extremos e erros; * Compreender a pirâmide de testes, escrever testes unitários de acordo com a regra de negócio e testes de integração com apoio de desenvolvedores sênior e do Líder Técnico; * Testar casos extremos e erros esperados, usar abordagem sistemática para depurar problemas e conhecer a filosofia de monitoramento da organização e os dados operacionais do domínio da equipe; * Entender o contexto do domínio de negócio, as boas práticas, padrões e processos do time, desenvolvendo funções que melhorem a qualidade do código e reduzam débito técnico; * Entender a importância da segurança nas implementações e envolver o Líder Técnico em decisões com implicação de segurança; * Atuar conforme a priorização de tarefas, identificando dependências entre tarefas e requisitos; * Desenhar estrutura de estado de aplicação e componentes reutilizáveis, com revisão de sênior ou especialista; * Aplicar diretrizes de acessibilidade e de performance de renderização (carregamento sob demanda, controle de re-render) de forma proativa; * Tratar erros de consumo de API com autonomia, incluindo falhas de rede e respostas inesperadas do back-end; * Escrever testes cobrindo os dois estados de funcionalidades de interface implementadas por trás de feature flag, com apoio de sênior. ### Perfil que buscamos * **Proatividade:** antecipa problemas de usabilidade ou performance antes de ser perguntado; * **Trabalho em equipe:** colabora com colegas de front, back e mobile sem precisar de mediação constante; * **Foco no cliente:** prioriza o que implementar pelo impacto real na experiência de quem usa a interface; * **Resolução de problemas:** decide como depurar e corrigir problemas de complexidade média com autonomia; * **Adaptabilidade e autoliderança:** transita entre demandas de complexidade crescente sem precisar de re-explicação constante de contexto; * **Boa comunicação:** traduz decisões técnicas de interface para quem não é desenvolvedor sem perder precisão. ### Informações da vaga * Contratação: PJ; * Modalidade: remota, com disponibilidade para viagens eventuais para encontros presenciais; * Horário: 08:00 às 17:30; * Formação: ensino superior completo ou em andamento, ou experiência equivalente comprovada na área; * Experiência: 2 a 4 anos na função. ## TruckPag:

Somos uma empresa de meios de pagamento especializada em gestão de frotas, com nosso cartão TruckPag, o cliente abastece com economia, facilidade e total controle. Com a CIOTPag, o cliente tem soluções completas para a sua gestão de frete a partir da emissão de CIOT e pagamento eletrônico de frete (PEF) . Além disso, a PagPedágio possibilita que as viagens sejam bem mais rápidas, sem precisar enfrentar filas de pedágios, em todo território nacional.

Somos 100% TruckPag: sem bancos, sem fundos, sem intermediadores e sem burocracia.

Veja mais no site ## Habilidades: - React - Tailwind CSS - Vitest - Typescript - Redux - Zustand - Docker - Figma - Testing Library - TanStack Query ## Local: Remota ## Requisitos: - React e TypeScript em nível intermediário, com capacidade de desenhar estrutura de estado e componentes reutilizáveis - Vite, Node (18 a 24) e gerenciador de pacotes (npm ou pnpm) - MUI v5 + Emotion + design system próprio (@truckpag/components) e Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Radix UI + Lucide - Gestão de estado: Redux + Redux Toolkit + Redux Saga (legado), Zustand (novos), TanStack Query e Context API ou Constate - Formulários com React Hook Form + Yup (legado) ou Zod (novos) - Tabelas com react-table v7 / material-react-table (legado) e TanStack Table v8 (novos) - Testes com Vitest, Testing Library e MSW para mock de API - Padronização de código: ESLint (@truckpag/eslint-config), Prettier, Husky, lint-staged, Commitlint ou Commitizen - Acessibilidade e responsividade de interfaces - Git e GitLab CI: escrever e entender .gitlab-ci.yml e participar do pipeline de build e teste do front-end - Experiência com CI/CD - Docker para ambiente de desenvolvimento local - Linux e uso de terminal como ambiente padrão de desenvolvimento - git-crypt para variáveis de ambiente - Figma: implementação fiel a partir do design entregue - Uso de IA no desenvolvimento no dia a dia (Cursor) - Integração entre sistemas via consumo de APIs - Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) - Noções de segurança da informação e prevenção de vulnerabilidades web no front-end (XSS, CSRF, CORS e CSP) ## Como se candidatar: Candidatar-se exclusivamente através da plataforma Coodesh no link a seguir: [Software Developer Front-end Pleno na TruckPag](https://coodesh.com/jobs/desenvolvedor-de-software-front-end-pleno-121748645?utm_source=github&utm_medium=frontendbr-vagas&modal=open) Após candidatar-se via plataforma Coodesh e validar o seu login, você poderá acompanhar e receber todas as interações do processo por lá. Utilize a opção **Pedir Feedback** entre uma etapa e outra na vaga que se candidatou. Isso fará com que a pessoa **Recruiter** responsável pelo processo na empresa receba a notificação. ## Labels #### Alocação Remoto #### Regime PJ #### Categoria Front-End

## **About Us**

We are a **rapidly growing software technology startup** from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT. Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago. As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

Are you seeking a company that transcends traditional constraints of location and time?

If you meet the following criteria, we want to work with you:

1. **Proactive and Independent:** Embrace the freedom to control your own working hours and enjoy the benefits of flexible schedules.
2. **Fully Remote:** Escape the confines of a traditional office setting and thrive in a fully remote work environment.
3. **Ownership and Involvement:** Crave a sense of involvement and autonomy, where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized.
4. **Strong Entrepreneurial Spirit:** High-energy, possess an adventurous and startup mindset, unafraid of embracing unknown challenges.
5. **Passion for the International Product:** Fuel your ambition by working on projects that transcend borders and embrace the opportunity to collaborate with teams across different parts of the world.

If you are driven, hard-working, and ready to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and embark on an exciting journey of innovation and growth!

**APPLY NOW:** **https://linktr.ee/growaha**

# **Job Description**

As a Senior Back-End Engineer, your pivotal role will encompass the design of a dynamic and scalable back-end architecture optimized for performance, and positioned to accommodate future product developments.

### **Your Journey as a Senior Back-End Engineer**

1. Our back-end primarily leverages **JavaScript** (Node.js). Proficiency in JavaScript is vital; however, applicants with experience in other languages like C, C++, C#, Java, Ruby, or GoLang, who can adapt to JavaScript swiftly, are welcome.
2. Our databases are SQL-based, primarily utilizing Postgres. We use ORMs for effective database interaction and management.
3. Our production infrastructure thrives on containers, K8, and AWS ECS.
4. Our work environment values teamwork.
    - Join hands with a cross-functional team throughout the development cycle, from designing to deploying APIs, SDKs, and other services or tooling.
    - Engage in code reviews to elevate your work and that of your colleagues.
    - Craft reusable and testable code for services and libraries that can be maintained seamlessly.
    - Collaborate with engineers across various departments to create remarkable features.
    - Work in unison with our product team to identify and tackle user pain points.
    - Champion improvements in engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
    - Develop innovative tools for internal teams.
    - Embrace ownership and responsibility for your work.
5. API development is a key facet of your role.
    - Design, build, and maintain APIs, services, and systems.
    - Create new APIs or enhance existing ones for our users.
6. Troubleshooting and debugging are indispensable skills.
    - Investigate, debug, and upgrade existing software systems, including the development and integration of new components or automation pipelines as needed.
    - Address production issues across services.
7. Engage in the launch of new markets, features, or products regularly.

### **What You Bring**

1. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
2. Five or more years of coding experience or an internship in a similar role.
3. Proficiency in web frameworks, especially JavaScript and Node.js.
4. Experience with databases like PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
5. Familiarity with quality control testing using tools such as QUnit, Mocha, Jasmine, or RSpec.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape the backbone of our software, empowering us to drive forward with innovative product advancements. Are you ready to take the lead?

### Additional Qualifications

We are seeking individuals who possess the following qualifications:

1. **Self-Motivation and Ownership:** Demonstrate self-motivation, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to manage your own work effectively.
2. **User-Centric Mindset:** Show a strong desire to meet user needs and a relentless pursuit of achievement and excellence.
3. **Adaptability and Quick Learning:** Exhibit a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to unfamiliar domains.
4. **Collaborative Spirit:** Display a willingness to actively participate in the team environment and collaborate effectively with diverse team members.

### Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive salary levels; details can be found at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha). Our salary structure includes flexible working hours, a fully remote setup, and monthly performance-based raises, bonuses, and rewards. 

### This Job Offers You

When you join our team, you can expect:

1. **Flexible and Independent Remote Work:** Enjoy the freedom of flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely.
2. **Performance-Based Rewards:** Receive rewards and bonuses based on your performance and contributions.
3. **Driven and Talented Co-workers:** Collaborate with a group of driven, creative, and multi-talented colleagues who share a deep passion for startups.
4. **Ownership and Impact:** Take direct ownership of your role and responsibilities, making a meaningful impact in our innovative culture.
5. **Learn to Solve Challenging Issues:** Work closely with teams dedicated to creating solutions for some of the most relevant and challenging issues.
6. **Positive Work Environment:** Thrive in a work environment built on trust, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, fearlessness, kindness, and respect.

Please review our **Pre-Interview Info at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)** before applying.

Ready to join our team? **Apply now at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)**.
